items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for public launch or monetization expansion; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Evidence: SearchWoot source rights remain unsupported; security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Keep the product private and preview-only. Human counsel is required before any rights-dependent launch, external rights request, affiliate use, advertising, or public data display.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Existing artifacts provide partial progress only: official API/terms/support documentation, repository/configuration files, privacy and cookie-policy pages, and draft terms. No task is closed because field-level rights, retention, deletion/correction/access, consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, rollback, and owner disposition remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked; user alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. Missing evidence and smallest next actions are recorded in the active launch-readiness work item. No rights-dependent public display, alerts, affiliate or advertising monetization, remarketing, or new tracking is cleared.

Fleet compliance is a technical baseline, not certification: 36 sites pass, 17 fail, and 6 are unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics quality is yellow because at least one source is unavailable or returning an error; do not treat failing sources as zero. Revenue evidence is limited to 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21, not site-attributable. Ordinary growth need not be blocked for incomplete telemetry, but no unsupported claims, ROI, causal lift, or site-level revenue assertions are permitted.

Maintain containment-only execution for legal scope. Do not admit new site-factory work, requeue unchanged failures, deploy, add tracking, expand monetization, alter consent or disclosures, or conduct external outreach. Continue only existing measurement, repair-or-close, parked-site readiness, compliance evidence, and launch-readiness evidence work. Keep scaffold properties parked, private, and preview-only until each receives a dated owner, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker packet.
